- [REQ-EX-003] Idempotency Check (EXPLICIT): The system must perform an idempotency check prior to transaction processing to prevent duplicate execution of identical transaction requests.

- [REQ-DJ-003] Account Balance Floor Enforcement and Overdraft Prevention (DERIVED_JUSTIFIED): The system must validate that source accounts do not violate minimum balance or overdraft limits prior to committing a debit entry, unless an explicit credit line or overdraft facility is authorized.
- [REQ-DJ-004] Deadlock Prevention and Timeout Guard for Concurrent Ledger Locking (DERIVED_JUSTIFIED): The system must acquire account locks in a deterministic, globally sorted order (e.g., sorting account IDs lexicographically) and enforce strict statement timeouts to prevent circular wait deadlocks during concurrent multi-account transfers.
- [REQ-DJ-005] Immutable Ledger Audit Trail and Append-Only Enforcement (DERIVED_JUSTIFIED): The system must prohibit UPDATE and DELETE operations on committed ledger transaction rows, ensuring that any corrections or reversals are executed strictly via compensating entries.
